description: Structured intake questions by task type. Agent asks only questions where the answer is missing AND not auto-answerable.

fix.question: What is the exact screen/URL where the bug occurs?
Does this happen for ALL records/branches, or only specific ones? If specific — which branch ID, date range, or record ID?
fix.hint: The #1 diagnostic question. A branch-specific bug points to data-level issues, not code-level.

fix.question: When did this start happening? Was it working before? Any recent deployments?
fix.hint: If it broke recently, git log on affected files will pinpoint the breaking change.

fix.question: Is this a DATA issue (wrong values stored in DB) or a DISPLAY issue (data exists but not shown correctly)?
fix.hint: Data issue = model/query fix. Display issue = JS/view fix.

fix.question: Is there a related screen that DOES work correctly for comparison?
fix.hint: A working reference lets us diff queries between broken and working cases.

feature.question: Who requested this feature? (client name or internal)
User story: As a [role], I want [action], so that [benefit].
Acceptance criteria — list each as: 'When [action], then [expected result]'. Minimum 3.
feature.hint: Each must be testable by running the app or checking DB.

feature.question: Is there an existing similar feature in the system? Which screen?
feature.auto_hint: Search knowledge brain for similar screens.

feature.question: Does this need new database tables or columns? Describe the data.
Does this feature interact with other modules? (billing, estimation, stock, etc.)
Is there a UI mockup or wireframe?

cr.question: What is the current behavior that needs to change?
What should the new behavior be after the change?
Why is this change needed? (business rule change, client request, compliance)
Which screens/URLs are affected?
cr.auto_hint: Grep for the function/table being changed.

cr.question: Should existing data be migrated, or only new records affected?

hotfix.question: Which client and branch is affected?
What is the immediate impact? (blocked operations, wrong financials, data corruption)
Is there a temporary workaround the client can use?

refactor.question: What code smell or issue are we fixing? (duplication, performance, readability)
What is the definition of done? How do we verify the refactor didn't break anything?
